overreach: R&S SMCV100B passages list EVM-related performance for 3GPP FDD with R&S SMCVB-K242 and custom digital modulation with R&S SMCVB-K199 [48]
R&S FSWX is described as usable for modulation-quality EVM cross-correlation and for characterizing components with stringent EVM requirements [49]
The small-cell WMT production demo lists EVM among TX test items and also states the demo is “1 BY 4 WITH PVT360A” with TX measurement by RF cable [16][18]

The same demo source is not a PVT360A datasheet, configuration guide, or features document, so it cannot be used to infer PVT360A RF, bandwidth, option, DUT-count, RF-path, connector, or 10 MHz reference specifications [17]
The passages do not provide a complete EVM measurement tutorial or complete 3GPP TS 38.521-1 text [52]
The passages warn not to infer all FR1, FR2, Wi-Fi, LTE, NR, or production-line EVM limits from the EVM page [52]
